title: Raku Magic! Group Experience
source_quote: Raku Magic! Come experience the magic of firing ceramics the Raku way!
evidence_sentence: The group experience page describes "Raku Magic!" where participants glaze pre-made pieces and experience raku firing.
evidence_quote: Come experience the magic of firing ceramics the Raku way! Raku firing is an ancient Japanese ceramics technique that has been used for many centuries to create a very unique finish to wares.
summary: Groups up to 6 people can participate in raku firing by glazing pre-made pieces and watching them fired. Contact the studio for fee and scheduling.
cost_text: Call for Class fee per person
how_to_join: Contact The Curious Forge at (530) 446-2777 or fill out group experience form
pay_text: Call for Class fee per person
